recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, high-contrast album cover featuring a central portrait of a smiling male musician in a blue suit, set against a saturated orange background with a vertical piano-key border and playful circular typographic elements.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical piano keys on the far left act as a structural frame.
Circular graphic containers for the primary title create a rhythmic, bouncing movement across the top.
A horizontal yellow band provides a high-contrast break for secondary information.
The subject's blue suit provides a cool-toned anchor against the warm orange and yellow field.
coreInvariants: Vertical piano keyboard motif on the left edge
Circular frames for individual letters in the main title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up portrait, slightly off-center to the right, occupying roughly 60% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and bright smile, positioned at the intersection of the upper-right quadrants.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the circular letters at the top, moves down the piano keys on the left, across the yellow bar, and settles on the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense composition with minimal negative space; the orange background serves as a flat, active field.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright Yellow (Horizontal band and secondary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all primary hues; values are mid-to-high to maintain a cheerful, energetic mood.

letterConstructionRules: Main title letters are individually placed inside alternating red and black circles.
Secondary text uses a condensed, heavy slab-serif for impact.
Body text is a clean, bold sans-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in circles are slightly rotated to suggest movement.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold geometric sans-serif for the primary name paired with a condensed slab-serif for the title.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric weight of the circular display text.
Provides the necessary slab-serif contrast for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a flat, saturated orange background. On the far left, place a vertical strip of stylized black and white piano keys. In the upper third, place a horizontal bright yellow bar. Position a studio portrait of a smiling Black man in a light blue suit on the right side, using a slightly vintage, warm-toned photographic style.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name across the top using white bold sans-serif letters, each inside its own circle (alternating red and black). Add the album title in red slab-serif on the yellow bar. Add a list of songs in yellow sans-serif on the left side of the orange field.

verificationChecks: Piano keys are strictly vertical on the left edge.
Main title letters are individually circled.
The yellow bar is perfectly horizontal.
The suit color is a distinct sky blue.

adjustableVariables: Circle colors for the main title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the high-saturation background.
Check that the piano keys do not overlap the subject's face.
Verify the circular text follows a rhythmic, non-linear path.
Confirm the yellow bar provides enough contrast for the red text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a saturated flat-color background with a vertical musical instrument motif border, a horizontal high-contrast band, and circular-framed display typography for a classic 1950s R&B aesthetic.
